svg.title: DIA-405 · Hurry Up and Wait
svg.desc: A flow map in which width is the number. A broad river of finished work runs from the left, 66.2 percent wider than the dashed lines that mark the same flow on teams that use AI little. It swells into a pool against a weir labelled the pass, where changes sat in review more than five times as long. Through the one opening in the weir a narrower stream runs on to the table: deployments, 11.7 percent narrower than their dashed baseline. From the table a broad rust band runs back along the bottom, 57.9 percent wider than its baseline: incidents a month. At the left it bends up and rejoins the river at its source, as new work. Vendor telemetry from 22,000 developers on 4,000 teams, compared and not randomized.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 5 · THE PASS
over five times as long in review
Width is the number. Each band is drawn against the same flow on teams that use AI little (dashed). Vendor telemetry, 4,000 teams, compared, not assigned.
DIA-405 · Teams using AI heavily finished 66.2% more work, deployed 11.7% less often, and had 57.9% more incidents a month.
